critique.evidence: The screen has a clear, distinctive red-vs-blue arena concept: an unusually forceful editorial headline, opposing mutator/defense chambers, a central attack trajectory, and a fraud-phylogeny artifact. The restrained cyan/crimson tactical palette and mutation-survivor language make it more memorable than a generic dashboard. The idea weakens on tablet/mobile, where the desktop genealogy becomes a conventional stacked list and the tablet navigation overlays the visualization.
critique.fix: Preserve the signature phylogeny on narrow screens with a compact interactive branching diagram, and prevent the sticky navigation from crossing the arena. Give the attack rounds a stronger battle/replay visual treatment so the central experience is as ownable as the headline.
